proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 4666 article gives Malayalam maṇ, maṇṇu earth (as one of the five elements), soil, mud, mudwall, wall, earth as opposed to heaven.. The Malayalam survey form maṇal “sand” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
